name: Gordunni Cobalt
summary: Orwin Gizzmick has just arrived in Feralas and heard that the Gordunni ogres keep interesting minerals buried. Orwin offers a shovel and asks you to head for the Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache, and dig up twelve samples of Gordunni cobalt, following the blue glow.

sections.title: Buried Minerals
sections.body: Orwin Gizzmick has only just reached Feralas and has heard the Gordunni ogres possess some interesting minerals. Orwin does not know what the ogres are up to, but they guard it fiercely and do not leave it lying about. They bury it, to keep folks like Orwin from getting hold of it. Orwin gives you a shovel. The Gordunni Outpost lies north of the camp; a blue glow shows where to dig. Twelve samples of Gordunni cobalt are wanted.

sections.title: When the Cobalt Is Delivered
sections.body: Orwin means to carry the cobalt along on further travels, certain someone will pay a pretty penny for it, and gives you something for your trouble.

faq.answer: Orwin Gizzmick, at Camp Mojache, who has just arrived in Feralas.
Buried in the Gordunni Outpost, north of Camp Mojache.

faq.q: How do you spot the buried cobalt?
faq.answer: A blue glow gives away the spot, and then you dig.

faq.q: Why do the ogres bury their cobalt?
faq.answer: Orwin says the ogres are protective of it and bury it to keep folks like Orwin from getting hold of it. What they want it for, Orwin cannot say.

faq.q: How much cobalt does Orwin want?
faq.answer: Twelve samples, dug up with Orwin's shovel.
